title: Kia Bakes a Cake
statementMd:
You are given a binary string $s$ of length $n$ and a tree $T$ with $n$ vertices. Let $k$ be the number of `1`s in $s$. We will construct a complete undirected weighted graph with $k$ vertices as follows:

- For each $1\le i\le n$ with $s_i = \mathtt{1}$, create a vertex labeled $i$.
- For any two vertices labeled $u$ and $v$ that are created in the above step, define the edge weight between them $w(u, v)$ as the distance$^{\text{∗}}$ between vertex $u$ and vertex $v$ in the tree $T$.

A **simple** path$^{\text{†}}$ that visits vertices labeled $v_1, v_2, \ldots, v_m$ in this order is *nice* if for all $1\le i\le m - 2$, the condition $2\cdot w(v_i, v_{i + 1})\le w(v_{i + 1}, v_{i + 2})$ holds. In other words, the weight of each edge in the path must be at least twice the weight of the previous edge. Note that $s_{v_i} = \mathtt{1}$ has to be satisfied for all $1\le i\le m$, as otherwise, there would be no vertex with the corresponding label.

For each vertex labeled $i$ ($1\le i\le n$ and $s_i = \mathtt{1}$) in the complete undirected weighted graph, determine the maximum number of vertices in any nice simple path starting from the vertex labeled $i$.

$^{\text{∗}}$The distance between two vertices $a$ and $b$ in a tree is equal to the number of edges on the unique simple path between vertex $a$ and vertex $b$.$^{\text{†}}$A path is a sequence of vertices $v_1, v_2, \ldots, v_m$ such that there is an edge between $v_i$ and $v_{i + 1}$ for all $1\le i\le m - 1$. A simple path is a path with no repeated vertices, i.e., $v_i\neq v_j$ for all $1\le i \lt j\le m$.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer $n$ ($1\le n\le 7\cdot10^4$) — the length of the binary string $s$ and the number of vertices in the tree $T$.

The second line of each test case contains a binary string with $n$ characters $s_1s_2\ldots s_n$ ($s_i\in \{\mathtt{0}, \mathtt{1}\}$) — the string representing the vertices to be constructed in the complete undirected weighted graph.

Each of the next $n - 1$ lines contains two integers $u$ and $v$ ($1\le u, v\le n$) — the endpoints of the edges of the tree $T$.

It is guaranteed that the given edges form a tree.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $7\cdot10^4$.

## Output

For each test case, output $n$ integers, the $i$-th integer representing the maximum number of vertices in any nice simple path starting from the vertex labeled $i$. If there is no vertex labeled $i$, i.e., $s_i = \mathtt{0}$, output $-1$ instead.

## Note

In the first test case, the tree $T$ and the constructed graph are as follows:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2c018d3678fcc993cea93af930f4bc10bd9d0bed.png) Left side is the tree $T$ with selected nodes colored yellow. The right side is the constructed complete graph.

The nice path shown in the diagram is $3\rightarrow 4\rightarrow 2$. The path is nice as $w(4, 2) = 2$ is at least twice of $w(3, 4) = 1$. Extending the path using $2\rightarrow 5$ is not possible as $w(2, 5) = 3$ is less than twice of $w(4, 2) = 2$.

In the second test case, the tree $T$ is a simple path of length $17$. An example of a nice path starting from the vertex labeled $2$ is $2\rightarrow 3\rightarrow 5\rightarrow 9\rightarrow 17$, which has edge weights of $1, 2, 4, 8$ doubling each time.
statementZhMd:
给定一个长度为 $n$ 的二进制字符串 $s$ 和一棵有 $n$ 个顶点的树 $T$。设 $k$ 为 $s$ 中 `1` 的个数。我们将按如下方式构造一个有 $k$ 个顶点的完全无向带权图：

- 对于每个满足 $s_i = \mathtt{1}$ 的 $1\le i\le n$，创建一个标号为 $i$ 的顶点。
- 对于上一步中创建的任意两个标号为 $u$ 和 $v$ 的顶点，定义它们之间的边权 $w(u, v)$ 为树 $T$ 中顶点 $u$ 与顶点 $v$ 之间的距离$^{\text{∗}}$。

一条依次经过标号为 $v_1, v_2, \ldots, v_m$ 的顶点的**简单**路径$^{\text{†}}$是 *nice* 的，如果对于所有 $1\le i\le m - 2$，条件 $2\cdot w(v_i, v_{i + 1})\le w(v_{i + 1}, v_{i + 2})$ 都成立。换句话说，路径中每条边的权值必须至少是前一条边权值的两倍。注意，对于所有 $1\le i\le m$，都必须满足 $s_{v_i} = \mathtt{1}$，否则将不存在具有对应标号的顶点。

对于该完全无向带权图中每个标号为 $i$（$1\le i\le n$ 且 $s_i = \mathtt{1}$）的顶点，求出从标号为 $i$ 的顶点出发的任意 nice 简单路径所含顶点数的最大值。

$^{\text{∗}}$树中两个顶点 $a$ 和 $b$ 之间的距离等于顶点 $a$ 与顶点 $b$ 之间唯一的简单路径上的边数。$^{\text{†}}$路径是一个顶点序列 $v_1, v_2, \ldots, v_m$，满足对所有 $1\le i\le m - 1$，$v_i$ 与 $v_{i + 1}$ 之间存在一条边。简单路径是指没有重复顶点的路径，即对所有 $1\le i \lt j\le m$，$v_i\neq v_j$。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1\le n\le 7\cdot10^4$）——表示二进制字符串 $s$ 的长度和树 $T$ 的顶点数。

每个测试用例的第二行包含一个由 $n$ 个字符组成的二进制字符串 $s_1s_2\ldots s_n$（$s_i\in \{\mathtt{0}, \mathtt{1}\}$）——该字符串表示要在完全无向带权图中构造的顶点。

接下来 $n - 1$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $u$ 和 $v$（$1\le u, v\le n$）——表示树 $T$ 的一条边的两个端点。

保证给定的边构成一棵树。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $7\cdot10^4$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出 $n$ 个整数，第 $i$ 个整数表示从标号为 $i$ 的顶点出发的任意 nice 简单路径所含顶点数的最大值。如果不存在标号为 $i$ 的顶点，即 $s_i = \mathtt{0}$，则改为输出 $-1$。

## 说明

在第一个测试用例中，树 $T$ 和构造出的图如下所示：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2c018d3678fcc993cea93af930f4bc10bd9d0bed.png) 左边是树 $T$，被选中的节点染成了黄色。右边是构造出的完全图。

图中展示的 nice 路径是 $3\rightarrow 4\rightarrow 2$。这条路径是 nice 的，因为 $w(4, 2) = 2$ 至少是 $w(3, 4) = 1$ 的两倍。无法通过 $2\rightarrow 5$ 继续延长该路径，因为 $w(2, 5) = 3$ 小于 $w(4, 2) = 2$ 的两倍。

在第二个测试用例中，树 $T$ 是一条长度为 $17$ 的简单路径。一条从标号为 $2$ 的顶点出发的 nice 路径的例子是 $2\rightarrow 3\rightarrow 5\rightarrow 9\rightarrow 17$，其边权依次为 $1, 2, 4, 8$，每次翻倍。
